derBytes.description: DER bytes of the imported certificates and of the configured targets' current CRLs (history not counted)

configured.description: false once the target was removed from config.json: nothing serves it

entries.description: Newest first: by thisUpdate, then CRL Number

current.description: The version the target serves: its current CRL, while it is in config.json

get.description: Reads the object store and config.json. `degraded` (still 200) while the service is not configured yet or its configuration is invalid; 503 when the store cannot be read.

200.description: The store answers: healthy, or degraded (configuration missing or invalid)

503.description: The store failed; the configuration could not be checked

get.description: Every imported certificate, in id order, with its catalog summary, config.json label, download paths and the targets it issues CRLs for. The whole list: no pagination.

500.description: The store failed, or it cannot back what catalog.json and config.json name (logged, never sent); retry later

get.description: The list item plus the decoded certificate: fingerprints, TBSCertificate (names, validity, public key, every extension), signature algorithm with its parameters and signature value.

schema.description: The certificate id: SHA-256 of the DER, hex (either case)

parameters.description: The certificate id: SHA-256 of the DER, hex (either case)
parameters.name: id

400.description: The id is not 64 hex digits

404.description: No certificate with this id is imported

500.description: The store failed, or it cannot back what catalog.json and config.json name (logged, never sent); retry later

get.description: Every target config.json defines, in targetId order, with its kind, label, issuer, download paths and current CRL summary (`current: null` while nothing is published). The whole list: no pagination.

500.description: The store failed, or it cannot back what catalog.json and config.json name (logged, never sent); retry later

post.description: One CRL, DER or a single X509 CRL PEM block, as the request body; the format is recognized from the bytes. It goes to the target that the configuration binds to its issuer (found by the Authority Key Identifier) and its kind (full or delta), once the extension policy, the issuer's signature and the comparison with the target's current CRL accept it. `Authorization: Bearer <AIA_UPLOAD_TOKEN>` is needed only while that token is set.

200.description: Updated; or `unchanged`: the same bytes are current, nothing was written

201.description: Published to a target without a current CRL

400.description: A malformed Authorization header, or an empty body

401.description: AIA_UPLOAD_TOKEN is set, and the token is missing or wrong

409.description: Not newer than the target's current CRL (`details.current`): stale_crl, conflict (other bytes for the same CRL Number and thisUpdate) or non_orderable (a CRL Number on one side only); or concurrent_update (the catalog kept changing: retry)

413.description: The body is larger than AIA_MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES

415.description: The Content-Type is missing or not one of the request body's media types

422.description: Not a CRL this service publishes: the code and `details` say why

500.description: The store failed, or it cannot back what catalog.json and config.json name (logged, never sent); retry later

get.description: The list item, and for a published target its current CRL decoded: verifier, fingerprints, TBSCertList with every revoked entry and extension, signature algorithm with its parameters and signature value. An unpublished target is a 200 with `current: null`.

schema.description: The target id from config.json (UUID, either case)

parameters.description: The target id from config.json (UUID, either case)
parameters.name: targetId

400.description: The target id is not a UUID

404.description: config.json defines no target with this id

500.description: The store failed, or it cannot back what catalog.json and config.json name (logged, never sent); retry later

get.description: Imported certificates, configured targets and published CRLs by kind, the revoked entries of the published full CRLs and the DER bytes of the certificates and current CRLs.

500.description: The store failed (logged, never sent); retry later

post.description: DER or a single PEM block, as the request body; the format is recognized from the bytes. Importing does not authorize anything: a certificate only issues CRLs once a config target names it. A PEM bundle is rejected (`pem_blocks`): the CLI sends each block on its own.

200.description: Already imported: the stored entry, nothing was written

400.description: Malformed Authorization header, or an invalid request

409.description: The catalog kept changing concurrently; retry

413.description: The body is larger than AIA_MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES

415.description: The Content-Type is missing or not one of the request body's media types

422.description: Not a certificate this service accepts; `details.reason` says why

503.description: No admin token is configured (AIA_ADMIN_TOKEN): the admin API is disabled

delete.description: Removes an imported certificate and its blob, unless config.json or the current CRL of a target (also of one removed from config.json) references it: then 409 `referenced` with `details.references`. The verifier of a target's current CRL stays referenced, also once the target is removed.

parameters.name: id

404.description: No certificate with this id is imported

409.description: Referenced, or the catalog kept changing concurrently (retry)

get.description: Every version that was published as the target's current CRL, newest first: the superseded ones and the current one, also for a target removed from config.json (retired). Blobs that a lost publish race left behind are not history.
